head_coach.name: Zlatko Dalić
head_coach.play_style_summary: Zlatko Dalić favors a possession-based, versatile tactical approach built around an elite, highly experienced midfield core. Under Dalić, Croatia excels in ball retention, high-tempo passing, and tactical adaptability. His style heavily utilizes situational third-player combinations to break defensive lines, shifting between a solid 4-2-3-1 and a 4-3-3 structure while maintaining a disciplined, compact defensive shape.

key_players.name: Joško Gvardiol
key_players.performance_stats: Maintained an 89.11% pass completion rate, 1.05 tackles per 90, 0.98 interceptions per 90, and 4.00 clearances per game [4.2.4]. Kept 13 clean sheets across 30 total matches in the 2025/2026 season.

key_players.name: Martin Baturina
key_players.performance_stats: Recorded an 87.7% pass completion rate, created 62 chances, and registered 8 big chances. Achieved an average FotMob rating of 7.24 across 41 matches in the 2025/2026 season.

key_players.name: Luka Modrić
key_players.performance_stats: Averaged a 7.58 FotMob rating over 2,816 minutes in 34 matches for AC Milan, showcasing exceptional playmaking, deep-lying distribution, and high-frequency chance creation.
